ja: この件、ずっと議論してるね。
en: We've been debating this for ages.
alternatives: We've been discussing this for ages.
We've been going back and forth on this.
point: 続いている動作は have been + -ing

ja: この案の方が明確だ。
en: This plan is clearer.
alternatives: This plan is easier to understand.
This plan is less confusing.
point: clearer は前の案などより分かりやすい。

ja: 我々は先に論点を整理すべき。
en: We should clarify the issues first.
alternatives: We ought to clarify the issues first.
We should sort out the points first.
point: clarify は曖昧な論点を明確にする。

ja: 質問していいですか？
en: May I ask a question?
alternatives: Can I ask a question?
Could I ask a question?
point: 許可を求めるなら May I / Can I。ask a question

ja: 彼らは誰が裏で操るか知らなそう。
en: I doubt they know who's pulling the strings.
alternatives: They may not know who's pulling the strings.
I'm not sure they know who's in control.
point: pull the strings は裏で実権を握り人を動かす。

ja: 我々が誰を不快にしてるか分かる？
en: Any idea whose feathers we're ruffling?
alternatives: Do you know who we are upsetting?
Do you know who is irritated by us?
point: ruffle feathers は人を不快にさせる。

ja: 彼女は我々に相違を整理させた。
en: She had us reconcile our differences.
alternatives: She made us resolve our disagreements.
She got us to settle our differences.
point: reconcile differences は相違をすり合わせる。

ja: 議事録は私が取ります？
en: Shall I take the minutes?
alternatives: Should I take the minutes?
Want me to take the minutes?
point: 議事録は複数形 minutes で the を付ける

ja: 我々の意見は私が集約する。
en: I'll consolidate our views.
alternatives: I'll bring our views together.
I'll combine our opinions.
point: consolidate は複数の意見を一つにまとめる。

ja: 予算があれば増員するのに。
en: If we had the budget, we'd hire.
alternatives: We'd hire if we had the budget.
If we could afford it, we'd hire.
point: if 節は過去形、主節は would＋原形

ja: 先に部長に確認すべきです。
en: We should ask the director first.
alternatives: We'd better check with the director first.
You should check with the director first.
We should check with the director first.
point: should は「〜したほうがいい」という助言

ja: 私は総括を頼まれた。
en: I was asked to sum up.
alternatives: They asked me to recap.
I've been asked to summarize.
point: 「頼まれた」は be asked to do

ja: 全員、これ見えます？
en: Can everyone see this?
alternatives: Can you all see this?
Can everybody see this?
point: 「見える」は can see。see は進行形にしない

ja: 私たちはもう懸念を解消した。
en: We've already allayed the concerns.
alternatives: We've already dispelled those concerns.
We've already put those concerns to rest.
point: allay concerns は懸念を和らげて解消すること。

ja: 資料を読んだので、次に行こう。
en: Having read the handout, let's move on.
alternatives: We've read the handout, so let's move on.
Now that we've read the handout, let's move on.
point: Having + 過去分詞で「済んだので」

ja: 決まり次第、全員にメールします。
en: I'll email everyone once it's decided.
alternatives: As soon as it's decided, I'll email everyone.
I'll email everyone as soon as it's settled.
point: 未来のことでも as soon as の後は現在形

ja: その件は会議のあとで詰めましょう。
en: Let's hash that out after the meeting.
alternatives: Let's sort that out after the meeting.
Let's iron that out after the meeting.
point: hash out は「議論して決着をつける」

ja: 私は目標を決めなきゃ。
en: I need to set goals.
alternatives: I have to choose goals.
I must decide on goals.
point: need to set は設定する必要がある。

ja: 今コピー配ってるよ。
en: I'm handing out copies.
alternatives: I'm passing out copies.
I'm giving out copies.
point: 「今〜している」は am + -ing。hand out は「配る」

ja: 田中さんが今発表中です。
en: Mr. Tanaka is presenting now.
alternatives: Mr. Tanaka is speaking now.
Mr. Tanaka is presenting right now.
point: 「今〜している」は is + -ing。男性なら Mr.

ja: 3時に始めます。
en: We start at three.
alternatives: We begin at three.
We're starting at three.
We'll start at three.
point: 時刻の前は at。予定の開始は現在形でも言える

ja: 先ほど出た案に賛成です。
en: I support the idea raised earlier.
alternatives: I'm in favor of the idea mentioned earlier.
I agree with the idea brought up earlier.
point: 名詞のあとに過去分詞を置いて説明する

ja: 意見が三つあります。
en: There are three opinions.
alternatives: We have three opinions.
There are three different opinions.
point: three の後は opinions と複数形。

ja: 昨日彼が議題を送ったよ。
en: He sent the agenda yesterday.
alternatives: He emailed the agenda yesterday.
He sent us the agenda yesterday.
point: send の過去形は sent。yesterday で過去とわかる

ja: 時間がないので、先へ飛ばそう。
en: Pressed for time, let's skip ahead.
alternatives: Since we're pressed for time, let's skip ahead.
Short on time, let's skip ahead.
point: Pressed for time で理由を軽く添える分詞構文

ja: もっと早く発言すればよかった。
en: I wish I'd spoken up sooner.
alternatives: I wish I had said something earlier.
If only I'd spoken up sooner.
point: 過去の後悔は wish + 過去完了

ja: 問題は、誰が責任を持つかです。
en: The issue is who will take ownership.
alternatives: What matters is who takes ownership.
The issue is who's going to own this.
point: who 以下は名詞節。語順は主語+動詞

ja: 我々が譲れば妥協点に達したのに。
en: If we'd conceded, we'd have reached a compromise.
alternatives: Had we conceded, we'd have reached a compromise.
We'd have found a compromise if we'd conceded.
point: concede は争点について相手の言い分を認める。

ja: 会議は短くしてね。
en: Keep the meeting short.
alternatives: Make the meeting short.
Keep the meeting brief.
point: keep 人や物 形容詞でその状態に保つ。

ja: 私は開始前に資料を送っていた。
en: I'd sent the slides beforehand.
alternatives: I'd already sent the slides beforehand.
I'd sent the slides before we started.
point: 「その前にすでに」は過去完了 had + 過去分詞

ja: 議事録は後ほど回覧されます。
en: The minutes will be circulated later.
alternatives: The minutes will be sent around later.
The minutes will be shared afterward.
point: 議事録は minutes と複数形

ja: 私は議論を脱線させたくない。
en: I want to avoid derailing the discussion.
alternatives: I don't want to derail the discussion.
I'd rather not derail the discussion.
point: avoid の後は動名詞、derail は脱線させる。

ja: 次の会議は私が進行します。
en: I'll lead the next meeting.
alternatives: I'll run the next meeting.
I'm going to chair the next one.
point: その場で決めた申し出は will

ja: 彼女はあえて反対役だったはず。
en: She must've been playing devil's advocate.
alternatives: She must've deliberately argued the other side.
She must've argued against it to test us.
point: play devil's advocate は議論を深めるため敢えて反対する。

ja: 私が進行役なら順番を変えるのに。
en: If I chaired, I'd change the order.
alternatives: I'd reorder things if I were chairing.
I'd change the order if I chaired.
point: chair は会議の進行役を務める動詞。

ja: 議題は残り二つです。
en: There are two items left.
alternatives: Two items are left.
We have two items left.
point: 複数のものには There are

ja: 昨日の会議は欠席した。
en: I missed yesterday's meeting.
alternatives: I missed the meeting yesterday.
I wasn't at yesterday's meeting.
point: 「欠席する」は miss。過去形は missed

ja: これが言っていた案です。
en: Here's the plan I mentioned.
alternatives: This is the plan I mentioned.
That's the plan I talked about.
point: 目的語の関係詞は省ける

ja: 見解は違うが方針は支持します。
en: Despite disagreeing, I support the approach.
alternatives: Although I disagree, I back the approach.
I support the approach despite my disagreement.
point: despite の後は名詞か動名詞。

ja: 私たちいつ会った？
en: When did we meet?
alternatives: When did we get together?
When did we see each other?
point: 過去の時点を尋ねるときは did we meet。

ja: 課長は来週で大丈夫と言ってた。
en: Our manager said next week would work.
alternatives: My boss said next week would be fine.
My manager said next week was fine.
point: said の後は時制が一つ後ろにずれる

ja: メモは私が取れますよ。
en: I can take notes.
alternatives: I can take the notes.
I'm happy to take notes.
point: 「メモを取る」は take notes。notes は複数形

ja: 私が先に話してもいい？
en: Can I speak first?
alternatives: May I go first?
Is it okay to speak first?
point: Can I で先に話す許可を求める。

ja: 失礼ですが、一点よろしいですか？
en: Might I raise one point?
alternatives: May I raise one point, please?
If I may, I'd like to raise a point.
point: Might I ～? で丁寧に切り出す

ja: 間違いでなければ、延期でしたよね？
en: If I'm not mistaken, it was postponed, right?
alternatives: Wasn't it postponed, if I'm not mistaken?
If I remember correctly, it was postponed, right?
point: If I'm not mistaken で断定を和らげる

ja: その案は先週、却下されましたよ。
en: That proposal was shot down last week.
alternatives: That proposal got shot down last week.
That proposal was turned down last week.
point: last week があれば過去形。現在完了は不可

ja: 部長は遅れています。
en: The manager is late.
alternatives: The manager is running late.
Our manager is late.
point: 「遅れている」は be late。is の後に動詞は不要
